name: unexpected-admin-group-change
condition: Ordinary account joins/rejoins administrative group, with corroborated administrator command, unusual remote account/group changes, or multiple targets; high-severity completed event
basis: MITRE ATT&CK T1078: abnormal use of valid accounts with elevated administrator group membership.

name: unexpected-elevated-command
condition: Newly promoted administrator executes a privileged command or first-seen remote address plus off-hours administrative execution; high-severity confirmed event
basis: MITRE ATT&CK T1068/T1078: unexpected privilege use following elevation or uncommon access circumstances.

name: new-address-admin-session
condition: Previously ordinary session becomes administrator-level with first-seen access address, high-severity confirmed event
basis: MITRE ATT&CK T1078: an established account unexpectedly gains high-privilege capability.

name: cross-account-privileged-use
condition: Privileged command executes under another account's rights with high-severity evidence
basis: MITRE ATT&CK T1078: anomalous use of a different account's elevated permissions.

name: privilege-review
condition: Low-confidence privilege prompts, command failure, non-admin group changes, isolated elevated commands or canceled attempts; alert only
basis: MITRE ATT&CK T1068/T1078: incomplete privilege indicators warrant investigation, not session revocation.
